tagline: 柯尼卡旁轴相机，1965 年发布
description: 柯尼卡于1965年推出的旁轴相机。配备Hexanon f/1.8, f=45mm 6 elements in 4 groups, 55mm filter。快门速度Copal SVA (B, 1, 2, 4, 8, 15, 30, 60, 125, 250, 500)。使用35 millimeter film in safety cartridge.。

specs.镜头: Hexanon f/1.8, f=45mm 6 elements in 4 groups, 55mm filter
specs.英文简介: The Konica Auto S2 is a Japanese 35mm fixed-lens rangefinder camera that was produced in 1965 by Konishiroku Photo Industry Company.
